headline: EPS flat sequentially, sharply higher y/y
summary_short: Sunny Friend Environmental Technology reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of NT$1.46, up 57.0% y/y from NT$0.93.
summary_long: Basic EPS of NT$1.46 rose 57.0% year-over-year from NT$0.93, and was roughly flat sequentially, down 3.3% from NT$1.51 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
